data.raw_text:
CHEd BACKS STUDENTS’ RIGHT TO PROTEST

READ: The Commission on Higher Education (CHEd) on Tuesday says students must “never be silenced, threatened, or intimidated for standing up against corruption.”

“Students have every right to demand accountability and good governance,” the statement reads.

CHEd says it supports the fight against corruption being waged by “President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., the youth, and the higher education community.”

“The voices of our students must not only be heard but also defended, for they are vital to building a just, transparent, and corruption-free Philippines,” the CHEd statement concludes.

(Source: Commission on Higher Education)
